description: SynD is a synthetic residential electricity benchmark created from recorded household-appliance power traces. The research team's own repository describes 180 days of aggregate and individual-appliance observations for 21 appliances at a temporal resolution of 5 Hz. Figshare supplies a 22-file CSV version, a NILMTK-compatible HDF5 version, appliance labels, metadata and the template power traces used by the simulation. Each inspected data deposit states CC0, allowing free reuse. The duration represents simulated days, not a calendar-based measurement campaign, and the own README does not establish a representative geographic population. These series can benchmark energy disaggregation and calibrate or test appliance-demand components of building simulations, complementing measured resources such as data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that synthetic activity sequences and a finite trace library may underrepresent real occupancy changes and appliance diversity. The provider also links introductory NILMTK notebooks; their existence does not establish benchmark accuracy for a particular model. No synthetic observations or trace archives were downloaded.
